blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型通过融合视觉感知,语言理解和动作生成,在机器人操纵方面展现出充满希望的能力. 最近的进展进一步纳入了未来的预测,以增进对环境动态和任务进展的理解。 然而,现有方法往往将短期动态和长期任务目标分别建模,同时将预测的未来直接纳入行动政策,而没有充分考虑到它们与当前行动要求的相关性。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议以行动指导世界检索为主的等级展望框架HIFOR。 具体来说,分级前瞻预测联合预测短期状态演化,语义里程碑,最终目标通过分级依赖性面具(HDM)来说明,建立跨时界的依赖性. 基于这些预测,结构-有意识的Latent World Modeling沿着地平线、视野和空间维度组织未来的潜在表述,以方便精细的检索。 此外, " 以行动为指针 " 的 " 因素世界检索 " 适应性地从结构化的潜在世界中取回相关未来信息,其依据是在解密期间不断变化的行动表述,为产生行动提供有针对性的指导。 两项模拟基准和六项现实世界机器人操纵任务的广泛实验,显示了我们的方法的有效性。

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models [ 19 , 16 , 46 , 56 , 34 , 29 , 59 , 26 ] have achieved remarkable progress in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation within a unified end-to-end framework. Benefiting from advances in large-scale vision-language models and the growing availability of diverse robotic demonstrations, recent VLA models have demonstrated promising capabilities across a wide range of manipulation tasks. As robotic manipulation tasks become increasingly complex, anticipating future environmental changes and task evolution becomes essential for effective action generation. To this end, recent studies have explored incorporating foresight capabilities into VLA models to enhance their understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression [ 27 , 18 , 43 ] . Existing approaches primarily predict future states or latent representations to model environmental dynamics [ 27 , 30 , 52 , 57 , 15 ] , or generate future images and videos to anticipate visual scene evolution [ 53 , 18 , 43 , 33 , 6 ] , thereby providing additional foresight information for action generation.
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模式[19,16,46,56,34,29,59,26]通过将视觉感知,语言理解,行动生成整合到统一的端到端框架内,在机器人操纵方面取得了显著进展. 近期的VLA模型得益于大规模视觉语言模型的进步和各种机器人演示的不断增多,在广泛的操纵任务中展现出很有希望的能力。 随着机器人操纵任务的日益复杂,预测未来的环境变化和任务演变对于有效采取行动至关重要。 为此,最近的一些研究探讨了将展望能力纳入甚低水平活动模式,以增进对环境动态和任务进展的理解[27、18、43]。 现有方法主要预测未来状态或潜在表现,以模拟环境动态[27、30、52、57、15],或生成未来图像和视频,以预测视觉场景演变[53、18、43、33、6],从而为行动生成提供额外的展望信息。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, effectively translating future predictions into actionable guidance for complex robotic manipulation remains challenging. First, modeling short-term world dynamics or long-term task objectives in isolation limits hierarchical coordination across temporal horizons. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), many existing foresight-based VLA methods primarily focus on a single prediction horizon. Short-term prediction methods [ 58 , 8 , 47 , 21 ] emphasize near-future environmental changes and local motion dynamics, capturing fine-grained state evolution but often lacking explicit connections to subsequent task stages and ultimate goals. In contrast, long-term prediction methods [ 53 , 9 , 54 , 36 , 28 ] provide intermediate task guidance through semantic subtask planning or visual subgoal prediction, enabling the policy to anticipate key future task states. However, these methods often lack sufficient modeling of the continuous state transitions and motion dynamics required to achieve such objectives. Although both forms of foresight provide valuable information, modeling them independently makes it difficult to establish explicit dependencies among local state evolution, key semantic milestones, and final task objectives, thereby limiting the policy’s coherent understanding of task progression across temporal horizons.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但有效地将未来的预测转化为对复杂的机器人操纵的可操作的指导仍然是挑战性的。 第一,孤立地模拟短期世界动态或长期任务目标限制了跨时间范围分级协调。 如图1(a)所说明的,许多现有的以展望为基础的紫外线法主要侧重于单一的预测前景。 短期预测方法 [58, 8, 47, 21] 强调近未来环境变化和地方运动动力学,捕捉到精细的状态演化,但往往与以后的任务阶段和最终目标缺乏明确的联系. 相形之下,长期预测方法[53,9,54,36,28]通过语义子任务规划或视觉子目标预测提供中间任务指导,使政策能够预测未来的关键任务状态. 然而,这些方法往往缺乏实现这些目的所需的持续状态过渡和运动动态的充分模型。 尽管两种展望形式都提供了宝贵的信息,但独立地模拟它们使得难以在本地国家演变、关键语义里程碑和最终任务目标之间建立明确的依存关系,从而限制了政策对跨时间范围的任务进展的一致理解。

blocks.en: More importantly, directly incorporating predicted future information into action generation often overlooks its varying relevance to current action requirements. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), many existing approaches [ 58 , 8 , 47 , 53 , 9 , 54 , 38 ] directly incorporate predicted future images or latent representations into action policies as additional conditioning signals, without sufficiently distinguishing the relevance of different predictions to current actions. However, future information across different prediction horizons, camera views, and spatial regions contributes differently to action generation, and its relevance dynamically evolves throughout task execution and the action generation process. Therefore, even with rich and complementary future predictions, selectively retrieving and utilizing information relevant to current action requirements remains essential for fully exploiting the decision-making potential of foresight. These observations motivate a unified framework that establishes hierarchical dependencies across temporal horizons and adaptively retrieves and leverages relevant future information according to current action requirements.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,将预测的未来信息直接纳入行动生成过程往往忽略了它与当前行动要求的不同相关性。 如图1(a)所示,许多现行办法[58、8、47、53、9、54、38]直接将预测的未来图像或潜在表述纳入行动政策,作为附加条件信号,同时没有充分区分不同预测与当前行动的相关性。 然而,不同预测视野、相机视图和空间区域的未来信息对行动生成有不同的贡献,其相关性在整个任务执行和行动生成过程中动态地演变。 因此,即使有了丰富而互补的未来预测,有选择地检索和利用与当前行动需要有关的信息,对于充分利用前瞻性的决策潜力仍然至关重要。 这些观测活动促使形成一个统一的框架,确立跨时间跨度的分级依存关系,并根据当前的行动需要,适应性地检索和利用未来相关信息。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose HiFOR , a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval for robotic manipulation. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), HiFOR integrates multi-horizon foresight prediction with action-guided selective retrieval, enabling future information across different temporal horizons to provide targeted guidance according to evolving action requirements. Specifically, ❶ we first introduce Hierarchical Foresight Prediction , which jointly predicts short-term state evolution, key semantic milestones, and final goal states. By incorporating a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), the prediction module establishes asymmetric dependencies across temporal horizons, connecting local motion dynamics with intermediate task progression and long-term objectives. ❷ Building upon these predictions, we propose Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling , which organizes predicted future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to construct a structured latent world while preserving fine-grained structural information for subsequent selective retrieval. ❸ Furthermore, we develop Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval , which leverages evolving action representations during denoising to perform factorized attention over the structured latent world. By adaptively evaluating the relevance of different prediction horizons, camera views, and spatial regions to current actions, the retrieved future information provides targeted guidance for action generation. Through these designs, HiFOR effectively integrates hierarchical future modeling with action-guided information retrieval, enabling foresight predictions to better support robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议HIFOR,一个以行动指导的世界检索为机器人操纵的分级展望框架。 如图1(b)所说明的,和睦团契将多视野展望预测与有行动指导的选择性检索结合起来,使不同时间范围的未来信息能够根据不断变化的行动要求提供有针对性的指导。 具体地说,我们首先引入了分级前瞻预测(Hierarchical Foresight Prespect),它共同预测了短期状态演变,关键的语义里程碑,以及最终目标状态. 通过纳入分级依赖性面具(HDM),预测模块建立跨时平面的不对称依赖性,将局部运动动态与中间任务进展和长期目标相连接. 基于这些预测,我们提出结构-智能后天世界模型(Structure-Award Latent World Modeling ),它沿着地平线、视野和空间维度组织预测的未来潜在表达,以构建一个结构化后地潜在的世界,同时保存精细的结构性信息,供后续选择性检索。 此外,我们开发了以行动为指南的 " 要素化世界检索 " ,利用在取消通知期间不断变化的行动表述,在结构化的潜在世界中进行要素化的注意。 通过适应性地评价不同预测视野、相机视图和空间区域与当前行动的相关性,所检索的未来信息为行动生成提供了有针对性的指导。 通过这些设计,HIFOR有效地将分级的未来模型与以行动为指南的信息检索相融合,使展望预测能够更好地支持机器人操纵.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: First, we propose a hierarchical foresight prediction mechanism that jointly models short-term state evolution, key semantic milestones, and final goal states through hierarchical dependency modeling, establishing explicit connections between local world dynamics and long-term task objectives. Second, we develop an action-guided structured world retrieval mechanism that adaptively retrieves future information relevant to current action requirements from a structured latent world organized along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions through denoising-aware factorized attention. Third, we conduct extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of HiFOR and further validating the contributions of its key components through comprehensive ablation studies.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 首先,我们提出一个分级展望预测机制,通过分级依赖模型,共同模拟短期状态演变,关键语义里程碑,以及最终目标,建立当地世界动态与长期任务目标之间的明确联系. 第二,我们发展了一个以行动为指南的结构化世界检索机制,通过淡化意识的分层注意,从一个沿着地平线、视野和空间维度排列的有结构的潜在世界中,以适应性的方式检索与当前行动要求有关的未来信息。 第三,我们对LIBERO,RoboTwin 2.0以及6个现实世界机器人操纵任务进行广泛的实验,通过全面的消化研究,展示HIFOR的有效性并进一步验证其关键部件的贡献.

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision-Language-Action Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景-语言-行动模式

blocks.en:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to integrate visual perception,
language understanding, and action generation to develop general-purpose
robotic policies capable of executing complex manipulation tasks.
Based on their action representations and generation mechanisms,
existing VLA models can be broadly categorized into two paradigms:
discrete and continuous action generation.

blocks.en:
Discrete action generation methods [ 4 , 3 , 19 , 48 , 54 , 31 , 44 , 23 , 45 ] convert continuous actions into discrete tokens or textual sequences,
enabling autoregressive action prediction.
In contrast, continuous action generation methods [ 17 , 2 , 16 , 22 , 13 ] typically employ specialized action prediction modules to directly
generate continuous control signals, mainly adopting regression-based,
diffusion-based, or flow-matching-based approaches.
Specifically, regression-based methods [ 17 , 42 ] directly learn mappings from observations to actions,
while diffusion-based methods [ 25 , 41 , 12 , 40 ] generate action sequences through iterative denoising.
Flow-matching-based methods [ 2 , 16 , 32 , 60 , 37 , 35 ] learn a continuous vector field to transform samples from a noise distribution into the target action distribution. Although these approaches have improved the action generation and generalization capabilities of VLA models, they primarily focus on action prediction itself, whereas accurate local action predictions do not necessarily guarantee successful completion of complex manipulation tasks.

blocks.en: 2.2 Foresight Predication in VLA
blocks.zh: 2.2 志愿军的前瞻预测

blocks.en: To overcome the limitations of local action prediction, recent studies have incorporated foresight prediction into VLA to anticipate future environmental changes and task progression, thereby guiding action generation. Based on how future information is represented, existing methods can be categorized into implicit and explicit foresight prediction. Implicit methods [ 27 , 30 , 52 , 57 , 15 , 49 ] model environmental dynamics in state or latent feature spaces, leveraging predicted future representations to facilitate policy learning and action generation. In contrast, explicit methods [ 53 , 18 , 43 , 33 , 6 , 7 ] generate future images or videos to anticipate visual scene evolution and potential action outcomes, supporting robotic planning and decision-making.
blocks.zh: 为了克服地方行动预测的局限性,最近的研究将展望预测纳入VLA,以预测未来的环境变化和任务进展,从而指导行动产生。 根据如何反映未来信息,现有方法可分为隐含和明确的预测。 隐含方法[27, 30, 52, 57, 15, 49] 状态或潜在特征空间中的环境动态模型,利用预测的未来表述促进政策学习和行动产生。 相形之下,明晰的方法[53,18,43,33,6,7]产生出未来的图像或视频来预测视觉场景演化和潜在的行动结果,支持机器人规划和决策.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, existing methods still face limitations in modeling and utilizing future information. First , predicting short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives in isolation overlooks dependencies across temporal horizons, limiting coherent modeling of task progression. Second , existing methods often directly incorporate predicted future information into action policies as additional conditioning signals, without adequately considering its varying relevance to current action requirements.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有方法在模拟和利用未来信息方面仍然面临局限性。 第一,孤立地预测短期动态和长期任务目标忽略了跨时空的依赖性,限制了对任务进展的连贯模式。 其次,现有方法往往直接将预测的未来信息纳入行动政策,作为附加的调节信号,而没有充分考虑到其对当前行动要求的不同相关性。

3.2 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 概览

blocks.en: The overall framework of our method is illustrated in Fig. 2 . Given a language instruction, multi-view visual observations, and the robot state, we first employ a VLA backbone to encode the current multimodal context and generate action representations. We then introduce Hierarchical Foresight Prediction (§ 3.4 ), which jointly predicts short-term state evolution, intermediate semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across prediction horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling (§ 3.5 ) organizes the predicted future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to construct a structured latent world model. Furthermore, we propose Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval (§ 3.6 ), which selectively retrieves action-relevant future information from the structured latent world to guide subsequent action generation. Together, these components enable our method to model hierarchical future evolution and selectively leverage relevant future information for action decision-making.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的总体框架如图2所示。鉴于语言教学、多视图视觉观察和机器人状态,我们首先使用VLA主干线来编码当前的多模式环境并生成动作表示。 随后,我们引入了分级前瞻预测(§3.4),它共同预测了短期状态演变,中间语义里程碑,以及最终目标通过分级依赖遮罩(HDM),建立跨预测视野的依赖性. 在这些预测的基础上,“结构-意识后天世界模型”(第3.5节)沿着地平线、视野和空间维度组织预测的未来潜在表达,以构建一个结构化后天世界模型。 此外,我们提议以 " 行动指南 " 要素化世界检索(第3.6节),有选择地从结构化的潜在世界中检索与行动相关的未来信息,以指导随后的行动产生。 这些组成部分合在一起,使我们的方法能够模拟今后层次的演变,并有选择地利用未来相关信息进行行动决策。

As illustrated in Fig. 3 , we first employ a
Planning Agent to generate a task-specific semantic template
from the language instruction 𝑳 \bm{L} , decomposing it into
an ordered sequence of subgoals 𝒢 = { G 1 , G 2 , … , G K } \mathcal{G}=\{G_{1},G_{2},\ldots,G_{K}\} .
Each subgoal specifies a semantic stage, an event type,
and a completion verification criterion.
For example, “Pick up the red mug and place it on the plate”

❷ move it to the target region , and

blocks.en: 3.4 Hierarchical Foresight Prediction

blocks.en: Complex robotic manipulation requires not only anticipating near-future environmental changes and motion dynamics but also understanding intermediate task progression and final goals. However, short-term world prediction and long-term semantic guidance in existing VLA methods often lack effective coordination, limiting their ability to capture task evolution across temporal scales. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Foresight Prediction . By establishing cross-horizon dependencies, our approach learns future representations that capture both local dynamics and long-term task objectives.

These predictions contain complementary information across temporal horizons, camera views, and spatial regions. However, organizing these predictions into a unified token sequence without explicitly preserving their structural attributes hinders the effective utilization of future information. blocks.en: 3.6 Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.6 行动指南 -- -- 因素化世界检索

blocks.en: After constructing the structured latent world, we further introduce Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval (AWR) . Since the relevance of future information to current action requirements may vary across denoising steps, we construct dynamic retrieval queries from the action expert’s hidden representations at each denoising step. We then perform factorized attention along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to selectively retrieve future information relevant to the ongoing action generation process.
blocks.zh: 在构建结构化的潜在世界之后,我们进一步引入了以行动为指南的因子化世界检索系统。 由于未来信息与当前行动要求的相关性可能因逐个取消通知的步骤而不同,我们从行动专家在每个取消通知的步骤中隐藏的陈述中构建动态检索查询。 然后,我们将注意力放在地平线、视野和空间维度上,有选择地检索与当前行动生成过程有关的未来信息。

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation on Simulation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价模拟基准

blocks.en: Simulation Benchmarks. To evaluate the robustness of our method under diverse simulated environments, we perform experiments on both LIBERO [ 24 ] and RoboTwin 2.0 [ 10 ] . For LIBERO [ 24 ] , we report the average success rate over four task suites, including Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long, where each suite contains 10 tasks. Each task suite is evaluated with 500 rollouts to obtain reliable performance statistics. For RoboTwin 2.0 [ 10 ] , we follow the Hard evaluation protocol and assess our method on 20 randomly selected tasks with 100 rollouts per task. The Hard setting introduces challenging domain randomizations, including variations in clutter, illumination, textures, and object heights.
blocks.zh: 模拟基准。 为了评价我们的方法在多种模拟环境中的稳健性,我们在LIBERO[24]和RoboTwin 2.0[10]上进行实验. 对于LIBERO [24],我们报告四个任务套房的平均成功率,包括空间,对象,目标,和龙,每个套房包含10个任务. 每个任务包都经过500次推广评估,以获得可靠的业绩统计。 对于RoboTwin 2.0 [10],我们遵循"硬评价协议",对20个随机选择的任务评估我们的方法,每个任务100个展开. " 硬"设置引入了具有挑战性的域随机化,包括杂交,发光,纹理,和物体高度的变化.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. All experiments are conducted on 8 × \times H200 GPUs with a global batch size of 512 (64 per GPU). Both LIBERO [ 24 ] and RoboTwin 2.0 [ 10 ] are trained end-to-end for 30000 optimization steps using AdamW. The learning rate is linearly warmed up to 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} over the first 5000 steps and then kept constant for the remaining training. We apply gradient clipping with a maximum norm of 1.0 and maintain an exponential moving average of the model parameters with a decay rate of 0.999.

blocks.en: Performance on RoboTwin 2.0 Benchmark. As shown in Table 1 , HiFOR achieves the best overall performance on RoboTwin 2.0 under the Hard setting, reaching an average success rate of 49.40% across 20 tasks, outperforming π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} by 9.05% . Specifically, HiFOR improves the success rates on Blocks Ranking RGB and Place Cans Plasticbox from 29% and 40% to 46% and 63% , respectively. Moreover, on Move Playingcard and Stack Blocks Two, HiFOR achieves success rates of 54% and 45% , surpassing the baseline by 14% and 13% , respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HiFOR in improving performance across diverse and challenging robotic manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: RoboTwin 2.0基准上的性能. 如表1所示,HIFOR在硬盘设置下在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了最佳的整体表现,在20项任务中的平均成功率达到49.40%,比 0.5\p_{0.5}高出9.05%。 具体地说,HIFOR提高了Blocks RGB和Place Can塑料盒的成功率,分别从29%和40%提高到了46%和63%. 此外,在"移动玩牌"和"堆积块2"上,HIFOR取得了54%和45%的成功率,分别超过了基准的14%和13%. 这些结果表明,和睦团契有效地改进了各种具有挑战性的机器人操纵任务的业绩。

blocks.en: Performance on LIBERO Benchmark. As shown in Table 2 , HiFOR achieves the best overall performance on LIBERO, with an average success rate of 98.3% . Specifically, it achieves the highest success rates of 99.4% , 98.6% and 95.8% on LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Goal and LIBERO-Long, respectively, while remaining highly competitive on other task suites. Compared with the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} baseline, HiFOR improves the average success rate from 96.9% to 98.3% , with the largest gain of 3.4% on long-horizon tasks. These results demonstrate that HiFOR effectively enhances long-horizon task execution while maintaining strong performance across diverse manipulation tasks.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation on Real-World
blocks.zh: 4.2 对现实世界的评价

blocks.en: Training and Evaluation Setting. To evaluate the effectiveness of HiFOR in real-world robotic manipulation, we conduct experiments on Generalization Tasks and Long-horizon Tasks using an AgileX Piper 6-DoF single-arm manipulator. The robot is equipped with a parallel-jaw gripper and two Intel RealSense D435i RGB cameras, providing wrist-mounted and third-person visual observations. For Generalization Tasks, we use 100 expert demonstrations per task for training, while Long-horizon Tasks use 200 demonstrations per task. All models are trained on 8 × \times H200 GPUs and deployed on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU for real-world evaluation. Both task categories are evaluated with 50 rollouts per task, with object positions randomly initialized in each rollout to assess robustness and generalization under varying initial conditions.

blocks.en: Key Component Analysis. We evaluate the key components of HiFOR through ablation studies in Table 3 . Introducing short-term foresight prediction improves the average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 from 40.35% to 44.15% , while incorporating milestone and goal predictions further increases it to 45.60% and 46.95% , respectively. Adding action-guided world retrieval (AWR) further raises the success rate to 49.40% , an additional gain of 2.45 %. Consistent improvements are also observed on LIBERO, particularly LIBERO-Long, where the success rate increases from 92.4% to 95.8% . These results highlight the complementary benefits of hierarchical foresight prediction and action-guided retrieval in effectively leveraging future information for robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 关键组成部分分析。 我们通过表3中的消化研究来评价和睦团契的关键组成部分。 采用短期展望预测可以提高RoboTwin 2.0的平均成功率,从40.35%提高到44.15%,同时纳入里程碑和目标预测将分别进一步提高到45.60%和46.95%。 加上由行动指导的世界检索(AWR)进一步将成功率提高到49.40%,额外收益为2.45%. 在LIBERO,尤其是LIBERO-Long,成功率从92.4%上升到95.8%。 这些成果突出表明了分级展望预测和以行动为指南的检索在有效利用未来信息进行机器人操纵方面的互补效益。

blocks.en: Different Short-horizon Prediction Length. We investigate the effect of different short-horizon prediction lengths on LIBERO, as illustrated in Fig. 5 . Specifically, we evaluate prediction horizons of 5, 10, and 15 steps. The 5-step horizon achieves success rates of 95.8% and 98.3% on LIBERO-Long and LIBERO-Avg, respectively. Notably, the policy updates its predictions every 5 execution steps on LIBERO, naturally aligning the 5-step prediction horizon with the action execution interval. This alignment enables short-term foresight to provide effective guidance within the current execution cycle, whereas longer prediction horizons extend beyond the next prediction update.
blocks.zh: 不同的短视预测长度. 如图5所示,我们调查不同短视预测长度对LIBERO的影响。 具体来说,我们评价了5、10和15个步骤的预测前景。 五步线在LIBERO-Long和LIBERO-Avg分别实现了95.8%和98.3%的成功率. 值得注意的是,该政策每5个执行步骤更新其关于LIBERO的预测,自然使5个步骤的预测前景与行动执行间隔相一致. 这种调整使短期展望能够在目前的执行周期内提供有效的指导,而较长的预测范围则超出下一次的预测更新。

blocks.en: Different Future Prediction Representations. We investigate the impact of different future prediction targets by comparing direct pixel-level prediction of future RGB images with semantic feature-based future prediction. As shown in Fig. 6 , RGB-based prediction improves success rates from 92.4% to 94.2% on LIBERO-Long and from 96.9% to 97.7% on LIBERO-Avg. Our method further achieves 95.8% and 98.3% , outperforming RGB-based prediction by 1.6 and 0.6 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the benefits of future-aware supervision and suggest that semantic feature-based prediction provides more effective guidance for action generation, particularly in long-horizon manipulation tasks.

blocks.en: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Attention Visualization. To investigate how our method utilizes structured future information, we visualize the hierarchical spatiotemporal attention at representative timesteps from three task stages. As shown in Fig. 7 , during stove activation, the model primarily attends to the milestone horizon (60%), focusing on the wrist view and stove control knob. During grasping, attention shifts toward the short-term horizon (52%), emphasizing local manipulation details from the wrist view. During final placement, the goal horizon receives the highest attention (53%), with the third-person view highlighting the target placement region. These results illustrate that our method adaptively retrieves task-relevant future information across temporal horizons, camera views, and spatial regions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight-guided framework for vision-language-action robotic manipulation. HiFOR employs Hierarchical Foresight Prediction to jointly predict short-term dynamics, intermediate semantic milestones, and final goal states, capturing dependencies across different prediction horizons. Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling further organizes these predictions along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to construct a structured latent world. Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval then adaptively retrieves action-relevant future information to guide subsequent action generation. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, together with real-world evaluations, demonstrate the effectiveness of HiFOR in improving robotic manipulation performance.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议HIFOR,这是视觉-语言-行动-机器人操控的分级指导框架. HIFOR使用分级前瞻预测来联合预测短期动态,中间语义里程碑,以及最终目标状态,捕捉不同预测视野的依赖性. 结构-有意识的Lateent World Modeling沿着地平线、视野和空间维度进一步组织这些预测,以构建一个结构化的潜在世界。 行动指南 " 因素化世界检索 " 然后适应性地检索与行动有关的未来信息,以指导今后的行动生成。 关于LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0的广泛实验,加上现实世界的评价,证明了HIFOR在提高机器人操纵性能方面的有效性.
